method.rating: Weighted z-score composite. Each metric is z-scored within its season, multiplied by its own win-correlation r (which carries the sign), then averaged weighted by |r|. Levers with |r| < 0.25 are excluded.
method.polarity_check: WARNING: 1 metric(s) correlate against declared polarity: d_rushing.tflRate
caveats: Descriptive correlation only — not causal, not opponent-adjusted.
